definitions.explanation: Slang term for someone who has difficulty communicating or socializing with others. Abbreviation of コミュニケーション{障害|しょうがい} (communication disorder), but used casually and often self-deprecatingly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コミュ{障|しょう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧。
examples.english: I'm socially awkward, so I have trouble talking to people I've just met.

examples.japanese: コミュ{障|しょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧やすい⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a job that's easy to work at even if you're socially awkward.

examples.japanese: 「コミュ{障|しょう}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自虐|じぎゃく}ネタ→自虐ネタ：22904_jigyakuneta⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: "Komyushou" is often used as self-deprecating humor.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Abbreviation of ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ (communication disorder). The clinical term has been adopted as casual slang with a much broader, less clinical meaning.

REGISTER: Casual/Slang
Primarily used among young people. Often used self-deprecatingly. The clinical origin means this term should be used carefully, as it can be insensitive to people with actual communication disorders.

USAGE:
- Very commonly used for self-description
- Can be seen as insensitive when used to describe others
- Often appears in discussions about social anxiety or introversion
- Sometimes written as コミュしょう with hiragana

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コミュ{障|しょう}⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (somewhat socially awkward)
- ⟦{重度|じゅうど}→重度：28683_juudo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コミュ{障|しょう} (severely socially awkward - humorous)
- コミュ{障|しょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}→克服：02805_kokufuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to overcome social awkwardness)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{人見知|ひとみし}り→人見知り：06622_hitomishiri⟧: shy around strangers (more neutral)
- ⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧: introverted (formal, clinical)
- ⟦コミュ{力|りょく}→コミュ力：08820_komyuryoku⟧: communication skills (abbreviated)
